_doc: Bounded-concurrency pool client (see AGENTS.md §7). Per-pod load = 80% of the single-pod max found by the calibration phase (CONNS_PER_POD overrides saturation.connections). The pod_ladder ramps pod COUNT until the 32-core wal server saturates, at 200k and 500k streams. fleet_cpu=2 matches the calibration; client_nodes sized so the top rung (pods x fleet_cpu) fits with headroom.
